note: Shot in Aetheria from a fresh install with only the starter set (npm run shots:site in Aetheria's repo).

shots.title: The Table
shots.text: Draw cards from the archive onto the bench: what is on the table is in the story. Dilys and Ansel of Lantern Quay come with every new archive, with the lorebook that knows their town.
shots.alt: The Table, with Dilys Pengelly, Ansel Truscott and the Lantern Quay lorebook laid on the bench

shots.title: A story
shots.text: A story in the manuscript: the speaker's portrait beside each passage, your own lines set apart, every take kept. This one, The Prism on the Milestone, comes with the pictures, written by hand.
shots.alt: A story page in Lantern Quay: Dilys Pengelly at the slipway at four in the morning, and your question before it

shots.title: The world
shots.text: A world is a map the story walks: Lantern Quay, its harbour, the flooded quarry and the road out, with where everyone stands.
shots.alt: The map of Lantern Quay, with Dilys Pengelly placed on the harbour and the route panel beside it

shots.title: Two guides
shots.text: Maelis or Ilario keeps the house with you. Either will show you where things are, answer your questions, and read beside you as you write.
shots.alt: The choice of guide: Maelis, Keeper of the Last Page, or Ilario, Lamplighter of the Unwritten

shots.title: The Library
shots.text: Everything you own, in decks you riffle through: characters, lorebooks, worlds, presets and what the stories remember.
shots.alt: The Library's Characters deck, with Dilys Pengelly's card at the centre

shots.title: A preset, read plainly
shots.text: A preset's instructions by what they do, your choices in plain words, and what each part costs before the story itself.
shots.alt: The Aetheria Storyteller's preset sheet, showing its choices and how many tokens it sends

shots.title: The Studio
shots.text: Make a character by interview: a line or two, then the questions that make them worth a story.
shots.alt: The Studio, starting a new character from a name and an idea

shots.title: A tour that points
shots.text: The guide's tours point at the very thing on the screen, one step at a time.
shots.alt: Maelis beginning the first tour of the house

phone.title: On a phone
phone.text: The same house on Android: the story fills the screen, and the rooms sit along the bottom.
phone.alt: The same story on a phone, with Table, Stories, Library, Workshop and More along the bottom
